name: engineering-flow
description: 工程工作流编排 (mattpocock idea→ship 内化): grill→spec→tickets→implement→review 阶段机。状态持久化到 ~/.veya/loops/<flow_id>.json。next=下一步动作, advance=阶段迁移, ticket_done=置票完成, review=双轴审查 diff, status=流程视图。

action.description: 操作: start=初始化流程, next=当前阶段下一步, advance=阶段迁移, ticket_done=票完成, review=双轴审查, status=状态视图

flow_id.description: 流程 id (状态持久化键, 默认 idea 的 slug)

spec.description: advance spec_written 用: spec 文本

interview_questions_json.description: advance run_interview 后注入访谈问题: [{id,title,body,options,recommended,depends_on,facts_needed}] JSON

answers_json.description: 记录访谈答案: {qid: answer} JSON
